abstract: First-principles electronic structure calculations have profoundly advanced research in physics, chemistry and materials science, yet their further development remains constrained by the accuracy-efficiency dilemma. Here we highlight recent breakthroughs in deep-learning methodologies that address this challenge, including the deep-learning quantum Monte Carlo method for the accurate study of correlated electrons and deep-learning density functional theory for efficient large-scale material simulations. These advances extend the reach of first-principles calculations to unprecedented scales and complexity, enhancing the impact of quantum mechanics in scientific discovery.
